characters.name: PEETER
characters.description: Väike inimene, poiss lühikeste pruunide juuste ja rohelise kampsuniga, lõbus ja sõbralik näoilme, sinised püksid. Armas multifilmistiil.

characters.name: LIISA
characters.description: Väike inimene, tüdruk kahe kollase patsi ja punase kampsuniga, naeratav ja uudishimulik näoilme, sinised püksid. Armas multifilmistiil.

locations.name: Mõnus elutuba
locations.description: Cozy living room with light blue walls, light wooden floor, a single large window on the back wall showing gray sky and autumn rain outside, a light brown sofa on the right side, plain light blue walls with no decorations, warm glowing lighting. Cartoon style.

pages.scene: Peeter and Liisa stand together near the large window in the living room, looking outside. Through the window, heavy autumn rain and cozy raindrops are visible against a gray autumn sky. Peeter wears a green sweater and blue pants. Liisa wears a red sweater with yellow braids. The living room has light blue walls, wooden floor, and a light brown sofa on the right.

Peeter and Liisa are standing in the center of the warm living room, smiling cheerfully at each other with a fun idea. Peeter wears his green sweater, Liisa wears her red sweater. The light brown sofa is on the right, light blue walls, wooden floor, and the window with rain outside is visible behind them.

Liisa is holding a soft yellow blanket and two colorful fluffy pillows near the sofa. Peeter stands nearby watching her with excitement. The room has light blue walls, light wooden floor, brown sofa, and rainy window background.

Peeter and Liisa work together to drape the large yellow blanket over the back of the sofa and a small wooden chair to create a cozy blanket fort on the living room floor. Peeter lifts one side of the blanket while Liisa tucks in a pillow under it.

A complete, cute blanket fort (blanket tent) made of yellow blanket stands neatly in the living room on the wooden floor. Soft pillows surround the opening. Peeter and Liisa stand next to it, clapping their hands in joy.
Peeter and Liisa are crawling happily on hands and knees into the opening of the yellow blanket fort on the floor. Peeter is entering first, smiling, and Liisa follows right behind him.

pages.text: PEETER JA LIISA JOOVAD SOOJA TEED.
pages.scene: Inside the yellow blanket fort, illuminated by warm soft glow, Peeter and Liisa are sitting cross-legged on soft pillows. Each child is holding a tiny toy mug, pretending to drink warm tea and smiling happily.

Peeter and Liisa look out from the cozy yellow blanket fort entrance, peeking into the living room. They are snuggled with soft pillows inside, looking extremely happy and content while rain falls outside the window far behind them.
